the_change.physics: The Maxwellian mean speed <v> = sqrt(8 k T / (pi m)) of the neutral gas. It is the single <v> the free-molecular neutral channels are built from.

old_form.mass_construction: mu_neutral * m_p_cgs -- the mass NUMBER times the proton mass
old_form.what_it_was: The _sim3 convention, inherited unchanged through every refactor. The docstring said only 'using the _sim3 convention', which named a provenance rather than stating what mass was used.

new_form.class: MEASURED (CODATA helium-4 atom mass, already the repository's canonical constant at cablp/constants.py:29)
new_form.why_constant_not_literal: cablp.constants is the single owning source for the helium mass; m_He_cgs is the same constant _gas_constants already hands the solver as ion_mass_g, and the same one sources.py's vbar_n already carried.

the_change.direction: vbar_n increases by 0.3305%. The old mass was 0.662% HIGH -- it neglects the helium binding-energy mass defect and the proton/neutron mass difference -- so the old speed was correspondingly LOW.
the_change.loaded_channels: Every free-molecular neutral transport coefficient: the Knudsen face conductances (D = (2/3) v_th R), the anode-mesh/baffle orifice conductance (0.25 v_th A_open), the two-zone exchange conductance, and the wall/pump rates derived from them. All scale linearly in v_th, so each moves by the same +0.3305% at fixed geometry.

mu_neutral_disposition.why_it_stays: Three callers in this module genuinely thread it -- knudsen_flow_coefficients (neutrals.py:63), neutral_zone_exchange_conductance (:190) and two_zone_knudsen_coefficients (:279) -- each fed from solver._mu_neutral (solver.py:839, 978, 983, 8707). Dropping the parameter would be a signature refactor across that chain, which is not this member's scope.

battery.why_fixed_dt: On the ADAPTIVE grid this instrument cannot resolve a smooth footprint: a 1-ulp perturbation flips the timestep selector at a near-tie and the arms end 4,000 steps apart at DIFFERENT physical times, so the deviation measures the time offset (floor ~1e-2, non-monotone in perturbation size). --fixed-dt pins the grid so both arms walk the same 4,000 instants and land on the same t_end by construction; a field difference can then only have come from the arithmetic.

measured_footprint.nn_reading: THE PREDICTED MOVER, AND IT MOVED. nn is the only field differing in ALL 72 cells (every other field differs in 71 of 72), which is what a change to the neutral transport coefficients themselves should look like: the neutral model is active pre-breakdown, so unlike sub-event 1b -- where nn moved least -- here the neutral field carries the perturbation first and most broadly.

largest_row_characterized.diagnosis: SMALL-DENOMINATOR ARTIFACT, not a physical outlier. The argmax is cell 16, where M_ref = -1.275305e-07 against a field scale max|M| = 7.3228e-06 -- i.e. the cell sits at 1.7% of the field maximum, near a sign change. Normalizing the same deviation on the field scale instead gives max|dM| / max|M| = 2.807e-04, in line with every other field (nn's equivalent is 3.369e-04). The rms_rel of 1.94e-03 is likewise two orders below the raw max.
largest_row_characterized.precedent: The identical row was characterized the identical way at R3 sub-event 1b, where M was also the largest ratio (1.044x prior).

defect_rule.rule_as_registered: x10 against the prior. The prior is ~3.3e-3 direct on vbar-fed channels (the relative change in vbar itself). Halt-and-report on any smooth observable exceeding 10x prior. Never widen.
defect_rule.DISPOSITION: ADJUDICATED ON EVERY ROW, NO FLAG RAISED, NO BAR MOVED. Every field sits below the x10 bar of 3.305e-02. The largest row is M at 4.792x the prior -- and that row is the small-denominator artifact characterized above; on the field-scale normalization it is 0.085x the prior. Six of seven fields sit at or below 0.21x the prior.
defect_rule.prediction_vs_measurement: The brief predicted REAL movement on nn this time, unlike 1b, because the neutral model is active pre-breakdown. HELD: nn is the only field perturbed in every cell. It also came in BELOW the direct prior (0.21x) rather than at it, which is the expected signature of a conductance change that has had only 0.47 ms to propagate.

battery.HORIZON_LIMITATION: 4,000 accepted steps = 0.47 ms is the PRE-BREAKDOWN foot only. This battery measures where the change enters, not what it does to the discharge or the afterglow.
